issue_context.title: [TaintBasedEvictions] Ensure test coverage is complete and up-to-date
issue_context.body:
As part of promoting TaintBasedEvictions to GA in 1.18 (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/87161), we need to make sure that the test coverage is sufficient. There are some tests mentioned in the KEP, and as mentioned in https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/1450#discussion_r366899543, those that are still under scheduling should be moved to the appropriate SIGs (sig-node or sig-cloud-provider)

/kind cleanup
comments: @fengzixu would you like to take this? It should mostly only be moving the tests from scheduling to an appropriate sig

After I detected related tests, I want to ask 

1. Where I need to move for integration test `TestTaintBasedEvictions ` ?  It seems like related to sig-node. But I didn't find the `node` directory under integration director.https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/47d5c3ef8df2b1b26da739aec0ada15d41f20cf3/test/integration/scheduler/taint_test.go#L580

Actually, I want to move it into the eviction directory.

@damemi @Huang-Wei  @ahg-g
Kindly ping @fengzixu what's the progress of this issue? Need any help?
Actually, I'm not quite sure about it. But I guess `TaintBasedEviction` is better to be put under sig-node. @Huang-Wei Do we have an agreement about where to put those tests?

~~@skilxn-go As the code mostly is located under `pkg/controller/nodelifecycle`, it's more reasonable to be owned by sig-apps. @damemi what's the latest status on this?~~

Per mentioned by @k82cn:

> sig-node takes the responsibility on nodelifecycle and nodeipm

Let's keep pursuing sig-node as the new owner.

sig-node takes the responsibility on nodelifecycle and nodeipm, please ping the approver in its OWNERS file; I can help on PR review if necessary.

Regarding integration test directory, `node/controller` or `node/lifecycle` is better as we may also add integration test for nodeipm.
According to the suggestion from @k82cn and @Huang-Wei . I plan to move the `TaintBasedEviction` into the node directory under `test/integration/`. It means I need to create a new directory.
@Huang-Wei spoke to @soltysh and @tnozicka from sig-apps, they also feel it is more appropriate under sig-node
@fengzixu are you still working on a PR for this? If so please link it to this issue so we can track it
@damemi Yep. Actually I have moved it into the eviction directory. I am revising it according to `move to sig-node` suggestion.

/reopen

review_comments:
SGTM! But different components have different `TestContext`, such as:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/test/integration/garbagecollector/garbage_collector_test.go#L200-L210
```go
type testContext struct {
	tearDown           func()
	gc                 *garbagecollector.GarbageCollector
	clientSet          clientset.Interface
	apiExtensionClient apiextensionsclientset.Interface
	dynamicClient      dynamic.Interface
	metadataClient     metadata.Interface
	startGC            func(workers int)
	// syncPeriod is how often the GC started with startGC will be resynced.
	syncPeriod time.Duration
}
```
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/test/integration/apiserver/admissionwebhook/admission_test.go#L69-L80

```go
type testContext struct {
	t *testing.T

	admissionHolder *holder

	client    dynamic.Interface
	clientset clientset.Interface
	verb      string
	gvr       schema.GroupVersionResource
	resource  metav1.APIResource
	resources map[schema.GroupVersionResource]metav1.APIResource
}
```
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/test/integration/volumescheduling/util.go#L42-L52

```go
type testContext struct {
	closeFn         framework.CloseFunc
	httpServer      *httptest.Server
	ns              *v1.Namespace
	clientSet       *clientset.Clientset
	informerFactory informers.SharedInformerFactory
	scheduler       *scheduler.Scheduler

	ctx      context.Context
	cancelFn context.CancelFunc
}
```

These `testContext` are very different. I'm a little concerned about whether it's appropriate to make `TestContext` as a public dependency.

Actually, I am moving the util functions of sig-scheduling and sig-node integration test. For different definitions of `testContext`, we can permit different sig has their own definition. If they decide to move it into the util. They need to adjust the definition of `TestContext` on util to adapt.

This PR is just for adapting changes of moving TainBasedEviction test from sig-scheduling to sig-node. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/87427
